name: d-op-v2
description: d-OP v2 Bun workspace (extension + share web + shared). The legacy root runtime was removed in task 25 after parity evidence; v1 source stays reachable via git tag v1.0.0. See docs/decisions/001-toolchain.md.

scripts.dev:extension: cd apps/extension && bunx wxt dev --browser chrome
scripts.dev:extension:firefox: cd apps/extension && bunx wxt dev --browser firefox
scripts.build: cd apps/extension && bunx wxt zip --browser chrome && bunx wxt zip --browser firefox && cd ../web && bunx astro build && cd ../.. && node ./scripts/pack-sources.mjs
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:worker && bun run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cd apps/extension && bunx wxt prepare && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cd ../web && bun run check
